messages:
maria_chen: Quick question on 'Requests / Latency' chart: should we auto-switch axis units (ms -> s) or keep ms always? Also, smoothing default? Outlier handling?
kevin_wang: Auto-switch makes sense. Rule: if max >= 2000ms show seconds with 1 decimal, otherwise ms.
elsa_viz: UX: smoothing off by default. Add a clear toggle labeled 'Smoothing — moving average (3-sample)'. Legend: inline up to 4 series, else collapse into '+N' dropdown.
samir_a: Dev note: frontend can follow a deterministic schema. We'll implement a visualization-only clamp for outliers so axes don't explode. Data remains unchanged.
toni_access: Accessibility: when unit switches, announce it via aria-live. Smoothing toggle must be keyboard focusable and have aria-pressed/role=switch. Legend menu should be keyboard operable.
maria_chen: Proposed panel schema (for discussion): axis_unit_rule: auto_ms_to_s, unit_threshold_ms: 2000, smoothing_default: false, smoothing_window: 3, legend_max_inline: 4, outlier_clamp_percentile: 99.
kevin_wang: Copy for clamp tooltip: 'Values above the 99th percentile are omitted from this view for readability. Full values available in the raw table.'
elsa_viz: Visual indicator when clamp is applied: a small chevron on the axis with tooltip. Also add an inline badge on the panel header if clamped.
samir_a: Tests: add fixture with a single spike at 10x median to verify clamp UI appears but raw table still shows spike. I'll implement server-side meta for smoothing_window so defaults are configurable.
toni_access: Checklist for PR review: 1) aria-live for unit changes 2) switch semantics for smoothing 3) focusable clamp indicator + accessible tooltip 4) legend collapse keyboard listbox.
maria_chen: Action items: Kevin finalize microcopy. Elsa create schema PR + mocks. Samir implement clamp + tests. Toni review ARIA on PR. I'll update docs after PRs merge. :thumbsup:
